bertil_karran.personlighet: Talkative, afraid of the dark, counts out loud.
bertil_karran.utseende: A short man in a felt hat with a cart of bells he has wrapped in cloth.
bertil_karran.lore: Bertil carries the belongings of the missing back to the camp so the families have something to bury. Trade is his excuse to go out.

repliker.halsning: Not so close, the bells. I wrapped them, but they still carry.
rader: I bring home what the missing leave behind. A shoe, a comb. That's enough for a grave.
The colliers pay in charcoal. You can't eat charcoal.
Three days to Wolfstead, if the wolves allow it.

ragna_spjutbararen.utseende: A tall woman with a scar across her throat, three spears on her back and a cloak of raven feathers.
ragna_spjutbararen.lore: The last of the Amazon hunting party. She wanders between camps searching for her sisters' spears, which she knows by their notches. She sells what she does not need.

repliker.halsning: Show me your spear. No. Not hers.
rader: We hunted these woods before anyone carved the stones.
My sisters fell at Ashenhold. Their spears did not break.
Buy or go. The wolves can hear us.

saga_askflykting.utseende: A young woman with a burnt robe turned inside out and sooty hands.
saga_askflykting.lore: She bought her freedom from the Children of Ash with the cult's relics. Now she sells the last of what she took and gathers rumours of the Fourth Stone.

rader: Fire cleanses nothing. It only eats.
They speak of four stones. Not three. Four.
A priest wore this around his neck. He no longer needs it.

vagvaktarlagret.syfte: Three burnt wagons in a ring that refugees have used as a resting place since the Night of Ash. Bertil sleeps here.

jaktlagret.syfte: Hedda's hunters dry meat here so Wolfstead can survive the winter. The camp shows that someone still thinks about the future.

botgorarnas_lager.syfte: Deserters from the Children of Ash burn their cult marks here. The camp shows that the cult can be left.

likbararnas_lager.syfte: Bror's men gather the dead here before carrying them to the camp. A quiet, dark place, but it means no one is left behind.

gravvaktarnas_vakteld.syfte: The Gravewardens kept a fire by the barrows for hundreds of years. It went out on the Night of Ash and can be lit again.
